{{Quote|Ship is letting you track it?''"<br />"''When it's above the canopy, we have a heat signature. When it's in the jungle, we have a damage path. As long as Ship is moving, we can track it.|Rhea and Walusari|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
'''Baad Walusari''' was a [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Sith Saber]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], he was chosen by [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea]] to be a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|Sith strike team]] sent to recover [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]], and hunt down [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. The strike team tracked Ship to a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], where the Meditation Sphere eventually returned to them. Ship then transported Walusari and the strike team to [[Sinkhole Station]] in the Maw. There, they [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|ambushed]] Skywalker and his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]]. During the battle, [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Yuvar Xal]] attempted to execute a coup to take over command of the strike team from Rhea, but Walusari and Rhea's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Vestara Khai]], foiled his betrayal. Khai then [[Death/Legends|murdered]] Xal, but Walusari was killed by the Skywalkers.

==Biography==
===Sith search===
{{Quote|A thousand meters at bearing one sixty from you. Ship just crossed the river and seems to be headed for the shuttle clearing.|Walusari, alerting the search party of Ship's presence|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
[[File:Lost_Sith_Tribe_world.jpg|thumb|right|275px|Kesh, Baad Walusari's homeworld]]
Baad Walusari was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] from the remote<ref name="Abyss" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. He was [[Sith training|trained]] in the ways of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] with the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]&mdash;descendants of a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who had been stranded on the planet during the days of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]&mdash;and achieved the rank of [[Sith Saber]].<ref name="Abyss" /> In [[41 ABY]],<ref name="41 date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the flashbacks of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', including [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship's]] arrival on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], to [[41 ABY]].</ref> [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]], arrived on the planet and began to help the Tribe form an [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]].<ref name="Omen" /> Two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the Tribe felt [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] presence in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] after he touched an [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Relics|relic]], the [[Codex]]. Shortly after, Ship abruptly left Kesh, following a call through the Force.<ref name="Omen" /> Walusari was then chosen by [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea]] to be a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] whose mission was to recover Ship and eliminate Skywalker.<ref name="Abyss" />

The strike team, led by Rhea, operated aboard the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Eternal Crusader]]''. They tracked Ship to a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], and Rhea led a search party down to the surface, leaving the ''Eternal Crusader'' in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. However, rather than leaving it under the command of her [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]], [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Yuvar Xal]], Rhea left Walusari in charge of the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], as she trusted the Sith Saber more than Xal. As the Sith searched vainly for Ship, Walusari attempted to find the Meditation Sphere using the ''Eternal Crusader''{{'s}} [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. After suffering several [[Death/Legends|fatalities]] from the planet's deadly [[Plant/Legends|plant]]-life, the search party made contact with [[Abeloth]], a being who was able to control the planet's flora and fauna. She agreed to help the Sith, although it was actually her call that had drawn Ship there, and her will that was preventing Ship from returning to the Sith.<ref name="Abyss" />

[[File:SithMeditationSphereShip-TERC.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ship, the Sith Meditation Sphere sought by Walusari and the Sith]]
Rhea finally decided that they should simply leave and go on to the task of eliminating Skywalker, but Walusari suddenly got a sensor lock on Ship. The search party resumed the hunt for the Meditation Sphere, but the chase continued with no success. Several [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] from the ''Eternal Crusader'' brought down more and more of the crew, including Walusari, until there was no one left aboard the warship. Abeloth, however, had recently discovered that Skywalker and his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], were at [[Sinkhole Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the Maw. She finally allowed Ship to return to the Tribe, and the Meditation Sphere transported the surviving Sith to Sinkhole Station.<ref name="Abyss" />

===Death===
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Now''!|Yuvar Xal, giving the order to attack the Skywalkers|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
[[File:Luke_Skywalker_EA.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Luke Skywalker, target of the Sith strike team]]
Rhea ordered Walusari, along with Rhea's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Vestara Khai]], to keep a watch on Xal and his apprentice, [[Ahri Raas]], as she expected them to attempt to betray her during the [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|battle]]. Walusari, along with Khai, Xal, and Raas, hid behind the hatches at a junction chamber that the Skywalkers would have to pass in order to reach their ship, the ''[[Jade Shadow]]'', in the station's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. After the Jedi escaped the first confrontation, Rhea [[Comlink/Legends|commed]] the four Sith to tell them that the Skywalkers were heading their way. Seeing their targets approach with [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] in hand, Khai and Walusari opened their hatches and each tossed a pair of [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] at the Jedi. Xal chose this moment to initiate his coup, and he and Raas [[Telekinesis/Legends|pushed]] the explosives back into Khai's and Walusari's hatches before throwing their own [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenades]] at the Skywalkers.<ref name="Abyss" />

Rhea had anticipated this move, however, and had provided Walusari and Khai with false grenades to throw first. Meanwhile, Ben Skywalker&mdash;who had escaped the effects of the [[Stun/Legends|stun]] grenades&mdash;pretended to be incapacitated by the blast. Raas moved forward to apprehend him but was distracted by Xal's cry of pain and surprise as the Sith Master was killed by Khai's [[shikkar]], and the Jedi quickly killed Raas. Walusari was the next to act, throwing a pair of [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenades]] at the Jedi, but the younger Skywalker pushed the grenades back into his hatch and shut the hatch down on his arm. Unable to escape in time, Walusari was killed by the grenades.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Crusader''. You have our position?''"<br />"''Affirmative.|Rhea and Walusari|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Baad Walusari was strong-willed and brave, as these were criteria for being chosen as a member of the strike team. He was also loyal to Rhea, who trusted him in return, placing the ''Eternal Crusader'' under his command and trusting him to keep a watch on Xal during the battle with the Skywalkers.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Powers and abilities==
Walusari learned the ways of the dark side of the Force on Kesh with the Lost Tribe of Sith.<ref name="Abyss" /> By 43 ABY,<ref name="Date" /> he had completed his training and had ascended to the rank of Sith Saber. He was a skilled combatant, as he was chosen to be a member of the strike team sent to eliminate Luke Skywalker.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Equipment==
Walusari was briefly put in charge of the ''Eternal Crusader'', using the vessel's systems to assist with the Sith's search for Ship. Later, he utilized stun grenades given to him by Rhea to attack Luke and Ben Skywalker. He later threw two fragmentation grenades at the Jedi, which were used against him to kill him.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
Baad Walusari appeared in [[Troy Denning]]'s [[2009]] novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third novel in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="Abyss" />
